article.title: NIQ與Google合作推進代理式購物，連結商品、庫存與行銷量度
article.title_en: NIQ and Google partner on agentic commerce, product data and measurement
article.summary: NIQ與Google於10月29日公布合作，擬把零售及商品情報接入AI購物生態，並推進Meridian與NIQ Cadence的行銷組合模型整合。
article.summary_en: NIQ and Google announced a collaboration on October 29 to connect retail and product intelligence with AI commerce and integrate Meridian into NIQ Cadence.
article.why: 對零售與消費品牌，商品資料完整度、門市可售資訊及增量量度可放在同一個評估框架。
article.why_en: Retail and consumer brands can assess product completeness, local availability and incremental measurement together.
article.next_step: 盤點商品識別碼、門市庫存更新及銷售資料可用性，再向供應商確認試點範圍與整合時間。
article.next_step_en: Audit product identifiers, stock updates and sales-data access, then confirm pilot scope and integration timing.
highlights: 合作重點包括商品探索及本地供應情況；具體項目與里程碑仍待後續公布。
NIQ亦指定Google Cloud為主要AI及雲端服務供應商之一，並計劃向全球員工部署Gemini for business。
highlights_en: The commerce work targets product discovery and local availability; specific initiatives and milestones will follow.
NIQ is naming Google Cloud a primary AI and cloud provider and plans workforce-wide Gemini for business deployment.
article.detail:
NIQ與Google於10月29日公布合作，擬把零售及商品情報接入AI購物生態，並推進Meridian與NIQ Cadence的行銷組合模型整合。

合作重點包括商品探索及本地供應情況；具體項目與里程碑仍待後續公布。

NIQ亦指定Google Cloud為主要AI及雲端服務供應商之一，並計劃向全球員工部署Gemini for business。

對零售與消費品牌，商品資料完整度、門市可售資訊及增量量度可放在同一個評估框架。

盤點商品識別碼、門市庫存更新及銷售資料可用性，再向供應商確認試點範圍與整合時間。

這是合作公告，並非全部功能已全面開放；公告未證明任何品牌已因合作獲得銷售增長。
article.detail_en:
NIQ and Google announced a collaboration on October 29 to connect retail and product intelligence with AI commerce and integrate Meridian into NIQ Cadence.

The commerce work targets product discovery and local availability; specific initiatives and milestones will follow.

NIQ is naming Google Cloud a primary AI and cloud provider and plans workforce-wide Gemini for business deployment.

Retail and consumer brands can assess product completeness, local availability and incremental measurement together.

Audit product identifiers, stock updates and sales-data access, then confirm pilot scope and integration timing.

This is a partnership announcement, not universal product availability or evidence of sales uplift.
